The survey includes questions about mental-health treatment and immigration status, which are classified as sensitive student data. Because of this, the project requires three specific conditions: explicit written consent from respondents, encrypted institutional storage of responses, and deletion of all research responses exactly 30 days after collection closes. I entered this determination in the privacy review system, which is separate from the draft proposal, so it may not have been visible to the rest of you yet.

commitments.detail: Email collection must be disabled on the survey platform before launch, and all existing test responses must be deleted.
Explicit written consent must be obtained from all respondents due to sensitive data questions about mental-health treatment and immigration status.
All research responses must be stored in encrypted institutional storage and deleted exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The survey must be capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents to comply with course credit requirements.
Results may only be presented at the closed university undergraduate symposium, not at any public presentation.
